turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! First, I solve one.
The word is "pen". Its first sound is "p", a consonant sound. So I write: Tom has a pen.
Rule: we say a before consonant sounds and an before vowel sounds.
Right: Tom has an apple.
Wrong: Tom has a apple.

Your turn. Write the missing word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
